englishOnly: This tool rewrites bullets written in English. Its verbs, templates and checks only work on English text, so the rewrites come back in English.
bulletLabel: Paste one bullet from your CV
bulletHint: One bullet at a time works best.
jobPlaceholder: Paste the posting to see which of its terms you could work in…
jobHint: Leave this empty to just rewrite the bullet.
privacy: Runs entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded or stored.
resultBody: Each one opens with an action verb and marks where a number belongs. The highlighted slots are yours to fill. This tool does not know your numbers, so pick figures you can defend in an interview.
fixTitle: What to fix in the original

notes.opener: Opens with "{opener}", which names a duty. Start with an action verb instead.
notes.verbOk: Opens with an action verb. Keep it and add the numbers.
notes.number: Has a number. Check it is the one a hiring manager cares about.
notes.noNumber: No number anywhere. Add how many, how often, how much, or how much faster.
notes.long: {count} words. Cut it to under 25 so it fits on two lines.
notes.pronoun: Uses "{word}". Drop pronouns from CV bullets and lead with the verb.
notes.vague: "{word}" hides the count. Replace it with the real figure.
notes.fullStop: Ends with a full stop. Use the same ending on every bullet.
notes.noFullStop: No full stop at the end. Fine, as long as every other bullet matches.

termsTitle: Terms from the posting you could work in
termsBody: The posting leans on these and your bullet never says them. Add only the ones you actually did.
termsTooShort: Paste more of the posting to see which of its terms this bullet is missing. A line or two is not enough to rank.
verbsSwap: Swap in whichever one is most accurate.

ownership.label: ownership and leadership
ownership.hint: You are describing something you owned or ran.

support.label: customer and people support
support.hint: You are describing work you did for customers or colleagues.

delivery.label: building and shipping
delivery.hint: You are describing something you helped build or launch.

process.label: process and efficiency
process.hint: You are describing a process you kept running or improved.

analysis.label: data and analysis
analysis.hint: You are describing something you measured or investigated.

general.label: general action verbs
general.hint: No single family stood out, so these work anywhere.

ctaTitle: One bullet down. What about the rest?
ctaBody: Paste the job link and FitMyCV rewrites every bullet against that posting, keeping your real experience and your real numbers.

rewrites.title: Three rewrites
rewrites.body: Each opens with an action verb and marks where your number goes.

read.title: A read on the original
read.body: Weak opener, missing number, pronouns, length. One line each.

verbs.title: A verb bank
verbs.body: Action verbs for the kind of work this bullet describes.
